1794 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 100, but 1794 not divisible by 4).  
Subtract 84 days from 1794-06-21.  
Back up 21 days to June 0 → 1794-05-31.  
Remaining 84 - 21 = 63 days earlier.  
May has 31 days, so back 31 days to April 0 → 1794-03-31.  
Remaining 63 - 31 = 32 days earlier.  
March has 31 days, so back 31 days to February 0 → 1794-01-31.  
Remaining 32 - 31 = 1 day earlier → 1794-01-30.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1794-01-30
